subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Is https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307 sufficient as the canonical fix for secondary-agent heartbeat identity under session.scope "global"?
rationale: The source-level root cause is clear and the open PR is narrow, but the issue should stay open until a maintainer accepts the PR's proof and lands or revises it.

options.title: Review and land the candidate PR
options.body: Accept the narrow AgentId-context fix if exact-head review and validation are still clean, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Request stronger live proof
options.body: Ask for a WSL2 or Docker multi-agent heartbeat run with the reporter's global-scope configuration before accepting the PR.

options.title: Reject the candidate shape
options.body: Close or revise the PR only if maintainers decide global-scope heartbeat identity needs a different owner-boundary fix.

recommendation.title: Review and land the candidate PR
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow AgentId-context fix if exact-head review and validation are still clean, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged the earlier adjacent cron isolated-agent reload repair and is a plausible reviewer for the gateway/heartbeat routing boundary.
